Asking for a friend. Kind of. Friend has trouble sleeping. I have trouble focusing on tasks and just keeping a tidy, clean mind.

For me, it's never quiet in there. Meditation is pretty much impossible. I have no idea what it's like to "not think about anything". Plus, it's almost like there isn't just one person, but multiple voices or noises in my mind. It doesn't help that my home environment is so annoyingly noisy.
Does anyone else feel like their brain is shooting things off at high speed? Like there are fireworks of thoughts going on? How do you manage this to get basic life things done? E.g., sleep.
Sex is the answer to everything. Or donuts.
This guy spends some time in a monastery and has a great explanation of how meditation quiets the manic thought train you describe.
Exercise and music work for me. Otherwise it is staying up to all goes of the night doing meaningless stuff just to try and execute on the ideas.

1. Cut sugar and caffeine.

  2. Be more active. Sleep comes easy when you are legitimately tired.

  3. Make a sleep ritual. The body has certain conditions. Your heartrate needs to slow down and your body temperature needs to drop. Make sure your sleepy place in genuinely comfortable.

  4. Give less fucks. After a certain time of day don't give certain thoughts any time. Tell you a story or think about snuggly blankies.

I believe when you are thinking about things at all times you are perhaps going too far forward or too far behind. Remember to stay present. That doesn't mean don't think about the future or don't think about the past but that the most important thing is what is happening right now.

Also amongst all the noise try to recognize what is fluff, if you will. If you're thinking about what you think someone else is thinking about or what they think about you or what they are going to do... then snap back and think...What is it I want and go from there...

Grounding yourself in the present is important and quitting with the idea of thinking about what others are thinking about... I used to have this habit. Be yourself and you'll find you naturally understand what people are thinking by being yourself and taking action.

This may all sound like gibberish but remember to breathe. Breath deep and try to breathe through your nose and use your stomach instead of your chest.

Best of luck and let me know if you need anything else. I'll try to conjure up some more thoughts.
